english.title: Drive carriage and failed to control it or quit / obstruct the highway
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a carriage, namely **(..SPECIFY CARRIAGE..), on part of a highway at **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY..),

(A)_[quit the same and went on the other side of the hedge or fence inclosing it]_
(B)_[negligently or wilfully were at such a distance from the carriage that you could not have the direction and government of the horses or cattle drawing it]_
(C)_[negligently or wilfully were in such a situation whilst the carriage was passing along the highway that you could not have the direction and government of the horses or cattle drawing it]_
(D)_[left a cart on the highway so as to cause obstruction thereof]_
(E)_[left a carriage on the highway so as to cause obstruction thereof]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 78 of the Highway Act 1835.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the driver of a carriage on part of the highway
quit the carriage and went on the other side of the fence or hedge enclosing it OR
negligently or wilfully were at such a distance from or were in such a situation while it was passing along the highway
that you could not have the direction and government of the horses or cattle drawing it OR
left a cart or carriage to cause obstruction of the highway
